development_baseline.name: v18 development predictions
development_baseline.recipe: v9 + 1.0 * v12 development residual on matched rows outside LIRF, then (1 - 0.7) * that + 0.7 * ens_v20_bag_q_all (out-of-sample per fold) on every row outside LIRF, floored; reproduces 330.302 / 271.528 / 192.187 on Jan / Jul / Nov 2025 (runs/adsb_v20_v2/selection.json). The baseline uses the recorded single-seed v12 development residual (parent v12_development_residuals), so the reproduction candidate below measures the residual seed bag alone.

development_scheme: leave-one-month-out over the three scoring months that hold out-of-sample v9 predictions (Jan and Jul 2025 from the seasonal fold, Nov 2025 from the forward fold); for each variant (scope, feature set) the residual model is fitted on the other two months' in-scope rows and applied to the held-out month's in-scope rows; every other row keeps v9

ens_v20_bag_q_all.rule: the incumbent committee (existing, hash-bound, not rebuilt)

ens_v21_lgb_lirf.rule: mean of finite predictions of the two LIRF-inclusive LightGBMs

ensembles.missing_members: if a learner variant fails to complete on all three folds it is dropped from every ensemble that lists it and the drop is recorded in the selection; no other change
ensembles.tool: tools/ensemble_adsb_full.py (per-row mean of finite member predictions, fold by fold); nested means are built by listing members with multiplicities that reproduce the weighted group means exactly (ens_v17_bag_ctr_q: each LightGBM five times and each of the five combination CatBoosts eighteen times, 120 entries; ens_v18_bag_c2: each LightGBM three times and each of the nine combination CatBoosts four times, 54 entries; ens_v18_bag_q: each LightGBM once and each of the nine combination CatBoosts twice, 24 entries); every learner predicts every non-LIRF row

execution.learner_fits_on_workers: tools/launch_adsb_learners.py --config configs/adsb_v21_v1.json (16 threads per fit, one chain on one worker, folds in sequence)

external_data.extraction: tools/adsb_extract_day.py keeps positions inside the ten aerodrome boxes that are on the ground or below 3,000 ft; per-day parquet with archive part hashes under data/external/adsblol/surface/ (the tool now skips and counts a corrupt archive member instead of aborting the day; the surface files used here predate that change and are unaffected)
external_data.license: Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0; feeder data CC0; licence files are inside every archive
external_data.matching: tools/build_adsb_features.py: ICAO callsign (CALLSIGN_flt, else FLIGHT_mvt) and takeoff within the track's ground-to-air transition; stand positions learned label-free from covered segments of Jan/Mar/Apr/Jul/Nov 2025 (1,111 stands); the pass-2 matches and stands are exactly the v11 inputs, snapshotted under data/external/adsblol/matches_v11/ and hash-bound below
external_data.source: adsb.lol globe_history daily archives (GitHub releases adsblol/globe_history_2025 and globe_history_2026, tags vYYYY.MM.DD-planes-readsb-prod-0)
external_data.v19_features: label-free features derived from the same adsb.lol surface positions (ODbL), stand names and runway names; docs/adsb_v19_screen/README.md items A-C

ens_v20_bag_q_all.description: the incumbent committee as declared above

floor_seconds_rule: minimum departure label over the refit months (-12), applied after the residual

incumbent.official_rank: not recorded (the user's standing rule: no leaderboard checks)
incumbent.recipe: v18 = (1 - 0.7) * (v9 + 1.0 * v12 ADS-B residual on matched rows outside LIRF) + 0.7 * ens_v20_bag_q_all (one quarter of the nine-LightGBM group mean, three quarters of the thirteen-member combination-CatBoost group mean, all without LIRF) on every row outside LIRF, floored; every LIRF row is v9 (configs/adsb_v20_v2.json, ens_v20_bag_q_all_70; uploaded 15:14 UTC 18 September 2026)

learner_common.catboost_base: configs/timeline_v1.json catboost block (depth 8, learning rate 0.055, l2 10, Bernoulli 0.8, rsm 0.9, max_ctr_complexity 1, one_hot_max_size 10, early stopping 200) with the overrides above and a 20,000-round cap
learner_common.excluded_airports: none for the v21 learners (LIRF included); instead the LIRF fill population (LIRF, no AOBT_3/LOBT clock, no aircraft type: exactly the v9 mixture's rows, 449 of the 506,751 development rows, 383 ranking rows) is left out of fitting and early stopping through the runner's new --exclude-population option; every row is still predicted
learner_common.features: timeline bundle CORE + FLOWN + SURFACE (276) + 27 ADS-B features from data/external/adsblol/matches (matches2_*, stands.parquet; hashes recorded in every run record); no v19 features (null inside LightGBM in v20)
learner_common.folds: seasonal and forward (out-of-sample fold predictions), refit on the eleven 2025 months at the median best iteration
learner_common.settings: configs/timeline_v1.json (lightgbm / catboost blocks; parameter overrides above)

lgb_lirf_cap_s32.note: as lgb_lirf_s31 plus --max-label 21600 (fitting and early-stopping rows with labels above six hours left out; every row predicted), seed 20260932

lgb_lirf_s31.note: timeline_v1 LightGBM parameters, fitted on every airport including LIRF with the LIRF fill population excluded, seed 20260931

selection_tool.note: lirf_nonpop scope, extra_blends, residual seed bag added 18 September

prior_evidence: Declared after the deep audit of 18 September (docs/audit_20260918/README.md): on the development rows with labels up to six hours, LIRF non-population departures carry 19.8% of the incumbent's squared error (37,406 rows, RMSE 357 s) and are predicted by v9 alone (v7's timeline models); every full-data learner so far was fitted without LIRF because the fill population's 80,000-second labels break early stopping, and the two LIRF attempts that lost (v12 residual on LIRF matched rows, v15 item 6 fill classifier) were residual/mixture models trained on one month of LIRF rows. LIRF is 80% ADS-B-matched in January 2026 and 0.2% in July 2026; the development months cover both regimes (Jan 2025 0%, Jul 94%, Nov 66%). The same audit found the v12 residual stage worth 0.95% and single-seeded. No v21 learner had been fitted and no bagged residual scored before this declaration.

residual_model.applies_to: the residual model is v12's (nb feature set, matched rows outside LIRF, weight 1.0) as a five-seed bag; each candidate then blends the result with ens_v20_bag_q_all at 0.7 on every row outside LIRF (the incumbent's blend), and the LIRF candidates add a second blend on the lirf_nonpop scope with a v21 learner table: value = (1 - w) * v9 + w * table there; LIRF population rows keep v9 exactly.
residual_model.blend: post-hoc convex combination with the extra table adsb_full (candidate_values in tools/run_adsb_v11.py); a NaN learner value leaves the row unblended
residual_model.prediction: v9 + weight * residual on in-scope rows, then floor
residual_model.rounds_rule: development: rounds per held-out month and variant (scope, feature set) come from a 5-fold day-grouped inner split of the two training months (median best iteration, 200 rounds patience, at most 4000); the held-out month is never used for rounds; export: median of the selected variant's three development round counts

scopes.all_no_lirf: every departure at any airport except LIRF: a blend scope only (unmatched rows there become (1 - w) * v9 + w * adsb_full)
scopes.lirf_nonpop: every LIRF departure outside the v9 mixture's fill population (airport == LIRF and not population): a blend scope only; rows there are (1 - w) * v9 + w * <table>, the population rows stay v9
scopes.matched_no_lirf: departures with a matched ADS-B surface segment at any airport except LIRF (adsb_matched == 1 and airport != LIRF): the residual model's training and prediction scope (exactly v12)

residual_model.seed_bag: five boosters with the declared parameters and every LightGBM seed (seed, bagging_seed, feature_fraction_seed, data_random_seed) set to each of `seeds`, all at the rounds chosen by the inner split with the declared parameters; the residual is their mean (fit_boosters / predict_residual in tools/run_adsb_v11.py; the export fits the same bag at the selected refit rounds and saves every member). The first member sets its seeds explicitly, so it is not bit-identical to the recorded single-seed residual; the reproduction candidate quantifies the bag.

selection: For each candidate, RMSE of the blended prediction on each held-out month versus the v18 development prediction (the incumbent's recipe on the same rows: all departures of the month). A candidate is eligible when it is not worse than v18 on ANY month (ratio <= 1.0), its mean ratio over the three months is at most 0.9998 (a 0.02% mean improvement: the standing rule since adsb_v20_v2, set here before any v21 learner is fitted or any bagged residual is scored), and every month's paired-day bootstrap interval of the RMSE difference to v18 lies below zero. Choose the eligible candidate with the lowest mean ratio to v18 (ties by name); otherwise select nothing. ens_v20_bag_q_all_70 can qualify on the residual seed bag alone. Ratios to v9 and per-airport tables are descriptive only. This is a LightGBM screen: if a LIRF candidate qualifies it is exported as the next version; if the LIRF candidates improve the LIRF non-population rows by at least 1% on the descriptive per-airport tables, a combination-CatBoost round with the same exclusion follows as a separate declaration.
